remarks: Situated on a desirable corner lot in Long Beach, this well-maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers timeless charm, generous living spaces, and the flexibility to make it your own. With approximately 1,510 square feet of living space, the home features spacious bedrooms, a master suite, a living room, a dining room, and a separate family room, providing plenty of room to relax, gather, and entertain. An additional bonus room with closet and storage space offers versatility for a home office, guest retreat, creative studio, 4th bedroom, or other personal needs.
